Fitline Gym Membership Options

The Standard plan costs 25 pounds per month. It includes access to the gym floor and changing rooms from 6am to 10pm, but classes cost extra.

The Premium plan costs 40 pounds per month. It includes 24-hour access, unlimited classes, and one personal training session per month.

Both plans require one month's notice to cancel. Students receive a 10 percent discount on either plan.

The pool is closed for maintenance until September.
